title: Agent mixtures and volatility clustering
purpose: Confirmatory test: do trend followers raise volatility clustering versus the random-order baseline
primary_outcome: VCI (mean ACF of absolute mid returns lags 1-10)
arms: A0 ZI; A1 ZI+TF; A2 ZI+MR; A3 ZI+TF+MR
planned_analysis: Paired percentile bootstrap 95% CI of mean VCI difference A1-A0; d_z; Holm for secondary contrasts

title: Liquidity supply and spread
purpose: Effect of ZI limit-order supply on spread and its interaction with trend followers
planned_analysis: Paired bootstrap CI of spread difference low-high liquidity (ZI-only); interaction on VCI secondary; Holm

title: Response to an exogenous sell shock
purpose: Drawdown and recovery after one large market sell across mixtures (optional under time budget)
planned_analysis: Paired bootstrap CI of drawdown difference ZI+TF minus ZI; censored recovery times descriptive

title: Sensitivity analyses that could invalidate EXP-001
purpose: Placebo-aggressiveness arm; tick size; sampling interval; exclusion of flagged runs
arms: A4 ZI+PA; A0 and A1 at tick 2; EXP-001 reanalysis at dt 10 and 200
planned_analysis: Paired bootstrap CIs; robustness rule in protocol section 4
